name: jump blossom
description: Nova blossoms over upstream official art: the jump and the character are Anthropic's `jumping happy`, the flower ring is hers, drawn in the Clawdmeter editor at 40x40. Frames 3-4 are the ring (laid on a circle, then an ellipse at the apex where a full circle will not fit the canvas); frames 5-7 are her scatter, untouched.
